fieldValues.title: How should a reader trust that a printed page matches its record?
fieldValues.thinking_reached: Raised by the 2026-11-27 tamper tests (Research: SRS carriers, part 4). No option chosen.
fieldValues.tensions:
Options, none chosen:
- A. Re-render the named composition from the payload and compare checksums; needs rendering that is deterministic across engine versions.
- B. Sign the carrier (a PDF signature covers page and attachment); proves authorship, not that the page follows from the record.
- C. Both: re-rendering for drift, signature for authorship.
- D. Store the rendered text as a record in the payload and compare text, so no engine is needed to check.
fieldValues.unresolved_questions: How often rendering changes between engine builds; whether readers will have an SRS engine; what a signature costs a small group to set up.
fieldValues.next_action: Re-render the essay slice with two engine builds and compare; try signing the prototype PDF.
